what: The wavy-border plate of the round button floating at bottom right keeps rotating once every 28 seconds linear, and on hover the character sitting on the button squashes and stretches over .4s with one bounce (1.1×.9 → 1.2×.8 → .9×1.2 up 35% → settle). When the element given in until (the footer) enters the screen, the button slides down and disappears over 2.4s expo, and returns when scrolling back up. With look: flip, on hover the icon (triangle) spins once around the Y axis over 1s expo instead of bouncing. It stays hidden until the top edge of the element given in after passes above the screen (a contact button absent on the first screen, floating from the next section on)

options.until: Hides when the top edge of this element enters the screen (css, e.g. footer) — if empty, always visible
options.--fx-drop: Distance to drop when hiding (via style), default 240px
options.[data-fx-part=figure]: Characters and icons that bounce on hover
options.after: Hidden until this element’s top edge passes above the screen (css, e.g. .news). Used with until, it is visible only in between
options.look: flip — on hover, instead of bouncing, [data-fx-part=figure] spins 360° on the Y axis over 1s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)
options.--fx-drop-ease: Hide and show Curve (set via style), default cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)
options.--fx-fade-dur: Opacity duration when hiding and showing (via style), default 1s
